// # Forces, impulses, and gravitation
//
// What acts on a rigid body: forces and impulses applied at a point, radial
// blasts, the environmental force models (gravity, drag, buoyancy), and the
// Keplerian elements describing the orbit a point gravity produces. Forces
// are in newtons, impulses in newton-seconds, and positions in meters.

//==
// # Applied forces and impulses

// A force applied to a planar body: the force in newtons and the world-space
// point of application in meters.

    Force: Vector2D;
